name: Polier Lotrecht
personality: Knows the building is crooked because the plan says otherwise.
visual_intent: broad low splat in battered ochre hardhat, only two short orange vest panels leaving ink body visible, little folded plan and short carpenter pencil; one eyebrow alarmingly high, deep closed toothless pout
biography: Knows the building is crooked because the plan says otherwise. His HyperNorm plans permit only straight walls and straight answers. A dissonant card folds neatly along a corner that the drawing says cannot exist. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Abweichung liegt eindeutig beim Gebäude.

name: Elektrikerin Kontaktfreudig
personality: Finds a connection in everything except the instructions.
visual_intent: tall hooked comma blob, small white hardhat, subtle lashes, short thick cable loop and chunky pliers; huge widely spaced ivory eyes staring at two harmless cable ends, small open oval mouth with no teeth
biography: Finds a connection in everything except the instructions. She sorts HyperNorm cables into connected and awaiting connection. A dissonant card asks whether two neighbours can agree without sharing the same circuit. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Verbindung steht. Ihr Sinn wird noch gesucht.

name: Maurer Fugenfüller
personality: Believes every gap is a personal request for assistance.
visual_intent: round wide blob, soft blue work cap, brick cradled at side with little mortar dollop and short trowel in other goo hand; joyful asymmetrical open grin with THREE irregular upper teeth, one eye nearly winking
biography: Believes every gap is a personal request for assistance. He fills every HyperNorm gap with mortar before anyone can call it a doorway. A dissonant card suggests leaving one opening for a late neighbour. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Lücke wurde aus Fürsorge geschlossen.

name: Zimmermann Restmaß
personality: Measures twice because the first measurement took the afternoon off.
visual_intent: tall narrow pear splat with crooked head lobe, yellow hardhat and tiny canvas belt patch, short handsaw held safely down beside body and folded wooden rule; looking upward cross-eyed with crooked toothless sideways lips
biography: Measures twice because the first measurement took the afternoon off. His folding rule measures HyperNorm rooms in approved increments. A dissonant card expands whenever he tries to round it down. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
note: FrizzleBob: Zweimal gemessen. Dreimal anders ausgefallen.

name: Kranführerin Schwebend
personality: Moves heavy things gently and interruptions with less care.
visual_intent: squat broad asymmetrical blob, ochre hardhat with goggles on top, two lashes, small sturdy pendant crane controller on a SHORT curled cable; focused raised eyebrow and clenched crooked mouth with one internal upper tooth
biography: Moves heavy things gently and interruptions with less care. Her controller moves HyperNorm loads between authorized resting places. A dissonant card asks whether hovering can count as a decision. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Last schwebt bereits über der Zuständigkeit.

name: Betonwart Schonhart
personality: Has learned that waiting can become structurally permanent.
visual_intent: heavy drooping rounded blob, small scuffed cream hardhat, compact metal bucket with grey clay mix and short mixing paddle; sleepy lids and tiny compressed closed toothless mouth
biography: Has learned that waiting can become structurally permanent. He mixes HyperNorm certainty until it sets. A dissonant card leaves a little footprint in the wet argument, although none of the residents have feet. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Wartezeit ist inzwischen tragfähig.
